headline: Brazil Stocks and Real Advance as Central Bank Holds Rate at 13.75%
summary: Brazil's main stock index gained 1.23% alongside a stronger real, supported by a Wall Street rally, while the central bank maintained its benchmark interest rate at 13.75% after the market close.
why: Monetary policy decisions and shifts in foreign exchange rates drive valuations across Latin American financial markets and domestic fixed-income assets.

impacts.name: Brazil
impacts.why: Maintained high interest rates and positive risk sentiment support local currency valuations.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The central bank rate decision combined with international equity rallies boosted local risk appetite and currency strength.
